def build_module_stubs_from_traces(traces: Iterable[CallTrace],
    max_typed_dict_size: int, existing_annotation_strategy:
    ExistingAnnotationStrategy=ExistingAnnotationStrategy.REPLICATE,
    rewriter: Optional[TypeRewriter]=None) ->Dict[str, ModuleStub]:
    defs = (
        get_updated_definition(func, traces, max_typed_dict_size, rewriter, existing_annotation_strategy)
        for func, traces in collections.defaultdict(set)
        .update({trace.func: trace for trace in traces})
        .items()
    )
    return build_module_stubs(defs)
